description: Translate or transliterate a street address into another language using WIA Address (OpenStreetMap Nominatim geocoding; for Korean addresses also the Korean government road-name address API). Returns structured fields, not an official postal confirmation. The address text is sent to third-party geocoding services. Do not use for mail delivery decisions without verifying with the local postal service. (한국어: 주소를 다른 언어 표기로 변환합니다.)

address.description: Full street address in any language, e.g. '서울 강남구 테헤란로 152' or '1600 Pennsylvania Avenue NW, Washington DC'

from.description: Language code of the input address (ISO 639-1/2, e.g. ko, en, ja)

to.description: Language code for the output (e.g. en, ja, ko)

name: address_translate
title: Translate a postal address
